newsitem.title: USA: Natgas futures end lower on soft bidweek prices.
newsitem.headline: Natgas futures end lower on soft bidweek prices.

text.p: NYMEX Henry Hub natgas futures ended lower across the board Tuesday in a moderate session, pressured most of the day by talk of softer September cash prices as bidweek wound down, industry sources said.
October slipped 5.5 cents to close at $1.882 per million British thermal units. November settled five cents lower at $2.039. Other deferreds ended down by 1.7 to four cents.
"People are discounting the hurricane (Edouard) and the cash got weaker during bidweek. At some point, you should see a rebound, but the question is when," said one East Coast trader.

At 1100 EDT, Hurricane Edouard, was 305 miles northeast of the Leeward Islands, moving west-northwest at 15 mph with winds of 130 mph. Forecasters expected the storm to move north of the Caribbean islands but were not sure if it posed a threat to the U.S. mainland.
And with little extreme Midwest or Northeast weather on the horizon, few expected cash or futures to rally much though a temporary technical bounce from an oversold condition was not ruled out.
Technically, traders pegged October support at today's low of $1.88, with resistance seen near $2.10.
U.S. Gulf Coast September prices slipped five cents or more Tuesday to the $1.75-1.80 area as most pipeline nomination deadlines expired. Sept Midcon pipes were off almost a dime to the mid-$1.60s.
The 12-month strip fell two cents to $2.048. NYMEX said 25,089 Henry Hub contracts traded, down sharply from Monday's revised tally of 60,948.

NYMEX September Permian natgas closed down five cents at $1.64, while deferreds settled steady to three cents lower but were untraded. NYMEX said 84 Permian contracts traded, up from Monday's total of 15.
NYMEX September Permian natgas futures expire Wednesday August 28.
On the KCBT, September expired 9.2 cents lower at $1.593, while deferreds ended steady to down 6.5 cents. The October East/West spread widened by one cent to 20.2 cents (NYMEX premium).
KCBT September natgas futures expire Tuesday, August 27.
